1. For the stationary transform, add rows and columns with the border mode until each side is a multiple of 2^J.
2. Split the channel with the stationary transform into an approximation and J levels of details, each at full size.
3. Estimate the noise sigma from the finest diagonal details, unless it is set.
4. Choose a threshold for each detail subband with the threshold rule, and shrink every detail coefficient.
5. Rebuild the channel with the inverse transform and remove the added rows and columns.
6. For cycle spinning instead, threshold n^2 circularly shifted copies with the decimated transform, shift each back and average them.
